title: What Python Is and How Programs Run Quiz
description: Check your understanding of Python as an instruction runner.

questions.question: What does Python do with your code?

options.text: It follows the instructions step by step
It guesses what the user wants automatically
It ignores errors and always produces output

questions.explanation: Python executes the instructions you write step by step.

questions.question: What is the output of the following code?
questions.explanation: Python runs from top to bottom, so it prints Start first, then Done.
